items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: And we had Paul McCartney on that night and he did three tunes

ctx.x: My tired shtick at SNL is if some artist comes in, some performer comes in to listen to their playback and they’ll say, “This sounds great, this sounds really nice.” And I’ll be like, “Look that attitu — oh you liked it, I’m sorry, never mind, never mind, it was something else never mind something else.” But you know because it’s a very difficult thing for them. I don’t care if you’re the first time you’ve ever been on the show or the tenth time you’ve performed on the show, to go from “Ladies and gentlemen” boom…

I know what the template is, I know what the stencil is every week. How that gets colored in I don’t know until Wednesday evening when I get the email that says this is what the music department requirements are for sketches and pre-records,” regardless of the theme, the closing theme, the bumpers, and the musical numbers, I don’t know what else is going to be in. When I was thinking about the choir there was another night, it was after that, it was Christmastime it was after that school shooting in Connecticut,…

Fascinating. In the recording projects you’ve done in the past and currently I’m wondering if you have a sort of a head — aural space that you prepare for depending on the gig. If you know you’re going to be recording a fusion band and is your mindset different than if you’re going to record a string quartet?
